Name: Seashell coop for AT
Author: Vi03
Description:
The idea was to make a custom building for some of my fav moded animals ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21055]Kelple by Fippsie[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16710]Axolotl by otohimexoxo[/url]) (Higly recomend them they are super cute) but i wasn't able to get it to work, so for now this is the best I could do. It's a complete cailure on my part but the building turned out really cute (in my opinion) so an at version was made.
If anyone has any idea how to make custom buildings and would like to make this into one, I would be forever thankful!
Pd: Huge shoutout to Wildflour's the bees knees apiary for the inspo to make this seashell building :).
